findReplaceableTypesAndDesignsForPiecesInDesign()

the selection is ONE connected subdesign / cluster.
We are NOT looking for candidates that can replace each selected piece independently.
We ARE looking for candidates that can replace the WHOLE selected cluster as a single object.

So the algorithm must work on the boundary of the selected cluster, not on the intersection of per-piece replacement sets.

ORE RULE


Let S = set of selected pieces.

1. Compute the INTERNAL connections of S:
   all connections whose two endpoints are both in S.

2. Compute the BOUNDARY connections of S:
   all connections with exactly one endpoint in S and the other endpoint outside S.

3. Ignore internal connections as external requirements.
   Internal selected-selected connections are inside the cluster and must NOT be treated as outside requirements.

4. For each boundary connection:
   use the ACTUAL opposite-side connector used by that actual connection,
   and derive a required boundary connector/port from it.

5. A candidate TYPE is valid iff the type has enough distinct compatible connectors
   to cover all boundary requirements of the whole selected cluster at once.

6. A candidate DESIGN is valid iff the design has enough distinct EXPOSED connectors
   to cover all boundary requirements of the whole selected cluster at once.

7. “Enough distinct connectors” means there must exist an injective matching:
   every boundary requirement is matched to a different candidate connector.
   One candidate connector may satisfy at most one boundary requirement.

8. Do NOT compute:
   “candidate is valid for each selected piece individually”.
   That is Meaning A and is not wanted here.

9. Do NOT intersect per-piece compatible sets.
   Instead compute one cluster boundary multiset and match against that.

10. If the selected cluster has no boundary connections:
    use the selected cluster’s own connector multiset as the requirement multiset.


VERY IMPORTANT CONSEQUENCES


- If the selection contains several pieces, a single TYPE candidate is only valid
  if one single piece of that type could replace the whole cluster boundary.
- If the selection is a multi-piece shape whose external boundary cannot be realized by one type,
  then TYPES must be empty, even if some type could replace each selected piece separately.
- DESIGNS may still survive when TYPES are empty, because a design can realize a larger boundary.


WHAT MUST CHANGE IN THE IMPLEMENTATION


Replace any logic that does this:
- for each selected piece
- find compatible candidates for that piece
- intersect them

That is wrong for Meaning B.

Instead do this:
- build one boundary multiset for the whole selected cluster
- match that cluster boundary against each candidate type/design

Also:
- remove any use of “whole opposite type connector union” as the requirement
- use the actual opposite connector used in the actual boundary connection
- for candidate designs, use only exposed/free connectors, not internal consumed connectors
- preserve multiplicity; do not collapse repeated requirements into a Set
- do not allow the same candidate connector to satisfy two requirements
